<thought>

This is N,N,2,3-tetramethylbut-2-enamide (or N,N-dimethyl-2,3-dimethylbut-2-enamide).

Let me verify the 1H NMR assignment makes sense:
- The two methyls on the double bond at positions 2 and 3: one gives 3H singlet, one gives 6H singlet (actually two equivalent methyls on C-2)
- Wait, let me reconsider the structure...

Actually, looking at CC(C)=C(C)C(=O)N(C)C:
- C1: CH3 (one of the methyls on C=C)
- C2: C(CH3) (quaternary carbon with one methyl)
- C3: =C(CH3) (sp2 carbon with one methyl)
- C4: C(=O) (carbonyl)
- C5: N(CH3)2 (two methyls on nitrogen)

So we have:
- 2 CH3 groups on C2 (the gem-dimethyl): 6H
- 1 CH3 on C3: 3H
- 2 CH3 on N: 6H

This matches: 1.79 (s, 3H), 1.92 (s, 6H), 2.67 (s, 6H)

The structure is confirmed!
